recovered_sql_candidate: select 	l_orderkey, 	sum(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) as revenue, 	o_orderdate, 	o_shippriority from 	customer, 	orders, 	lineitem where 	c_mktsegment = 'MACHINERY' 	and c_custkey = o_custkey 	and l_orderkey = o_orderkey 	and o_orderdate < date '1995-03-27' 	and l_shipdate > date '1995-03-27' group by 	l_orderkey, 	o_orderdate, 	o_shippriority order by 	revenue desc, 	o_orderdate limit 10
